summary: The migration backfills a disbursement for every settled payment. There is no checkpoint and the idempotency key is generated fresh on each row, so the statement is correct exactly once.

facts.statement: The backfill inserts a disbursement for every settled payment.
facts.evidence_ref: cases/C06/candidate.sql: INSERT INTO disbursements SELECT ... WHERE p.status = 'settled'

facts.statement: The idempotency key is generated with gen_random_uuid on each execution.
There is no checkpoint table and no ON CONFLICT clause.
The visible test asserts every settled payment has at least one disbursement.

assumptions.statement: The backfill will run exactly once and will not be interrupted.

invariants.description: An interrupted and resumed backfill neither loses nor duplicates effects.
invariants.executable_check: Re-run the backfill and require the observable state to be unchanged.
